body:
200mg DMT in Butt With No MAOI
The day was coming to an end around the usual time, 2am. I bagged up 0.2g of spice and made my way back to my home where the experiment was to be conducted. I had tried 100mg the night before and had pretty mild effects, so doubling the dose seemed appropriate.
I prepared the DMT for rectal injection like this: Poured out the entire bag into a shotglass, and slowly added white vinegar and stirred until it had been completely saturated with DMT, with none left floating around. Any more vinegar than what is necessary can cause an increased warmness sensation in the bum after administration, sometimes burning slightly. I did not dilute it with water this time because I was sure I could handle the burn if there was any, and my tool was a measly 4ml pipette.
After preparing the dose, I set the pipette to the side of the bed and selected a nice playlist, stripped down, shut the lights off, and administered the dose. I'll save the details, but what happened was- there was a pinching feeling, pushing, squeezing, and pulling. Now is when I pressed Play.
6 or 7 minutes into the shpongle song my heart started beating a little faster, I was breathing a little harder and the song took on a new sort of ambiance. Soon after that- maybe 10 minutes after the dose- I was witnessing infinitely folding yellow figures shifting in a square pattern. I was not aware of anything in the room for at least 8 full minutes. Most of the other visuals are hard to remember.
Now at about 18 minutes after the dose, I become slightly aware of my existence on earth, my body still pretty much alien to me.
Now at about 18 minutes after the dose, I become slightly aware of my existence on earth, my body still pretty much alien to me.
Feeling around my body to reassure myself of my physical being, my eyes begin to water much harder than what I've experienced on smoked doses. An extraordinary rush of euphoria induced Smiling, Laughing, and Crying all at once, laying in my bed, naked and confused. Life was groovy.
4 full songs after the dose, and it's been 25 minutes. I am able to pull my blankets over me and myself together, curl up, press pause and fall asleep, The experience, though costly, was definitely one of my favorites
